dimensions.detail: The files consistently describe a news-reporting skill: fetch AI news from AIMPACT/ME News APIs, filter and sort it, then format a report.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Most triggers are AIMPACT-specific, but the phrase "生成 AI 日报" is broad enough to catch a generic AI daily-report request.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown instruction files only, requires curl for API requests, and has no executable installer or bundled script.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access to agent.me.news and optional use of web_fetch/message are disclosed and proportionate for a news and push-notification workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not create persistence itself or store credentials, but it provides user-directed cron and Windows task examples for recurring report delivery.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger is real, but the resulting behavior is limited to disclosed news API fetching and report generation, so this is a scoping note rather than a Review-level concern.
[SQP-2] expected: Optional message delivery fits the stated reporting purpose and is disclosed as requiring preconfigured channels; users should verify recipients before enabling it.
[VirusTotal-pending] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was pending and provided no negative artifact-backed signal.
llm.guidance: Install this if you want AIMPACT/ME News AI reports. Review any configured message channel and scheduled tasks before enabling push delivery, because reports may be sent externally on the schedule you configure.
llm.summary: This skill fetches AIMPACT/ME News AI news from disclosed API endpoints and can optionally send scheduled reports through user-configured channels.
